question: Can a complete tiny royal rook/knight game provide cheap exact WDL labels without material rewards?
rules: King royal; ordinary R/N movement and capture; no castling/pawns/promotion/drops; checkmate loss, stalemate draw; infinite nonterminal play draw. No eight-board insufficient-material shortcut, no history draw.
decision: Only use exact graph when closure+retrograde validation PASS; then mature-search choice labels can be actual proven WDL, not numeric material or shallow mate score. Tiny-domain values conditional, not human Chess recovery.
